paragraphs.text: The Tanglefoot Trot will return to Pontotoc on Saturday, November 14, with 10K, 5K and one-mile fun-run options benefiting CATCH Kids, Inc.

The registration listing gives a 9 a.m. Central start and sets the online sign-up deadline for Thursday, November 12, at 9 p.m. Central. Participants can use the event registration page linked below to sign up.
Now in its 14th year, the event takes place along the Tanglefoot Trail. The registration page identifies the Tanglefoot Trail Gateway in Pontotoc as the event location.
The fundraiser supports the nonprofit's work providing free medical and dental care to children in northeast Mississippi, according to the event description.
